finding: The no-site repair changes the production import topology as well as the attack surface. Product boot must not silently restore ambient site/CWD imports after V4 admission.

primary_evidence.finding: The normally prepended script/current-directory path is considered potentially unsafe and is suppressed by -P; -I implies -P. A program may explicitly modify sys.path for its own purposes.
runpy.run_path on a simple script executes that file in a fresh namespace; only when the supplied path itself is a valid sys.path entry such as a directory/zip is it prepended to sys.path.

inference: A production target executed as a simple script through the V4 run_path path cannot assume its repository/script directory is importable under -I -S. If the real Frank runtime imports sibling/project modules, the trusted launcher must establish an explicit, provenance-bound import root after admission or use another attested package/image layout. Re-enabling ambient site processing would reopen the class just falsified.
required_product_test: Resolve the canonical production entrypoint and exact source/package identity first.
Start with the exact admitted Python executable and -I -S before any import-capable Frank Python code.
Add only an explicitly attested source/package root after V4 admission if real runtime imports require it; bind the path to accepted source/binary provenance.
Reject unexpected/mutable path entries and demonstrate that site/CWD/user-site are absent from the accepted import graph.
Run the real token API/runtime dependency graph, not only synthetic V17 and disposable UnifiedDB pair gates, under this topology.
Fail closed on source-root/package/hash drift and preserve a boot receipt of sys.executable, sys.flags, sys.path and admitted artifact identities.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The final Frank executable/package may not require any repository-local Python import path at runtime, in which case an explicit source-root addition is unnecessary and should be omitted. Resolve this from the real product dependency graph rather than adding path machinery preemptively.
